event_text: m_c took a walk through an especially muddy and dense part of the territory, the next day {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} woke up sore.

m_c was out in the territory when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} came across a cluster of red berries, deciding to eat some thinking they were edible, later r_c found them barely alive and rushed {PRONOUN/m_c/object} back to camp.
Whilst m_c was working on a pathway through the dense undergrowth, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} nicked {PRONOUN/m_c/self} when weaving through the branches of a spiky tree.

Whilst m_c was stalking through the tall grass of the marsh hunting, for a brief moment {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} could've sworn {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} felt something slither by, and was proven correct when a snake's fangs sunk into {PRONOUN/m_c/object}!
